page: Microsoft Azure L128aos_v5 is a high-capacity virtual machine belonging to the Laosv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor with an x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this server type is its massive local storage capacity, offering 92,159 GB of local storage. Additionally, the instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes. The configuration does not include any onboard GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the substantial local storage volume and high memory density, this instance is designed for resource-intensive workloads. It offers qualitative cost efficiency for operations requiring massive local data caching, large-scale databases, and big data analytics by consolidating compute, memory, and storage resources into a single node. Suitable workloads include large relational databases, data warehousing, and extensive transactional processing systems.
